name: daguild
description: Project-agnostic delegation crew of six agents (investigator, builder, architect, reviewer, security, scribe) with a per-project charter.

git_handling.description: Let daguild handle git: a generic git skill plus a guard hook that denies AI attribution, --no-verify and forced pushes. Off: your project's own git conventions apply.
